questions.stemHtml: A 27-year-old male is brought to the emergency department after falling from his ladder while cleaning the gutter. After the initial trauma survey, an X-ray film is taken of the right upper extremity and is shown here. Which of the following neurologic deficits is most likely to occur with this type of fracture?

options.label: A
options.text: Inability to fully abduct the arm

options.label: B
options.text: Inability to hold a piece of paper between fingers

options.label: C
options.text: Pain over the palmar aspects of the first three and a half digits I
